summary: One authenticated cold read (gpt-5.6-sol@high, read-only) returned four gaps and four contradictions. All eight were answerable from repository facts and were resolved against the repo, not escalated; no owner choice remained. The task plan was amended once and the pass is recorded against the amended version.
gaps: The `user_facing: true` amendment has no falsifiable functional target. `.factory/stories/FORGE-COORD-1/task-plans/LEAN-WORKFLOW.md:21` refers only to an unspecified board-wording change; Verification Plan step 6 merely requests a functional checker, and Manual Verification step 8 says to confirm “board wording” without naming the route, exact copy, prior state, or expected observable result.

The native-approval security boundary omits accepted Decision 0082. The implementation contract and reviewer focus require stable Codex session/event identity but never state that authenticity rests on invocation of the exact hash-approved hook, provides no signed-host provenance, and excludes synthetic same-user invocation (`docs/decisions/0082-codex-hook-trust-boundary.md:17-28`). That is a load-bearing trust seam for AC1-AC2.

AC16 and AC17 have no falsifiable required test or verify command. The protected decomposition’s 55 required tests cover AC13-AC15 but none validates the 4/6/8 timing arithmetic, the 15% repeatability limit, the 25% setup predicate, the fixture-adoption decision, or retained coverage. `factory/schemas/test-automated.json:6-18` accepts free-form command and summary strings, so merely recording benchmark prose in `tests.json` does not enforce either criterion.

The handover does not make its closing command reachable from the current authoritative runtime state. `./forge next` routes to GATES-1 and refuses on its retired fixed proof, while the shared protected `.git/forge/run.json` names GATES-1; the plan nevertheless proceeds directly to `./forge task close LEAN-WORKFLOW` without specifying a validated FORGE-COORD-1 reactivation or attach transition that preserves the other active story.
contradictions: The decision grounding is stale and internally impossible. `.factory/stories/FORGE-COORD-1/task-plans/LEAN-WORKFLOW.md:8` claims the accepted corpus only through 0078, but the active corpus includes accepted 0079, 0080, 0081, and 0082. Lines 50-51 still call the full-access destination Decision 0079 even though 0079 is now `a-task-proof-runs-once-per-tree`, 0080 is native role routing, and the accepted full-access decision is 0081.

The three-profile acceptance target contradicts current authority and its own required test. The plan’s scope and AC8 require only three Forge-owned profiles (`LEAN-WORKFLOW.md:17,62`), while accepted Decision 0080 requires the complete routed role registry (`docs/decisions/0080-native-role-model-routing.md:23-40,54-59`) and `factory/tests/test_native_setup.py:454-469` asserts sixteen installed/configured agent roles rather than three.

The “Current implementation blockers” section is not current. `LEAN-WORKFLOW.md:81` presents the `a835534` 36-failure run and four nonexistent selectors as the outstanding state, but committed `verify.json` records all five verify commands and all 55 required selectors passing at `c8f7128`, and the inspected HEAD is later still at `678f233`. The plan does not identify the actual remaining work for that tree.

The stated base and review limits disagree with both the current tree and the authoritative contract. `LEAN-WORKFLOW.md:83,96-97` says `git merge-base HEAD origin/main` must equal `aa8b519c1e1e` and uses a 118-file/23,000-line ceiling; the command currently returns `9e08774ba4973f54d0b2805f6f84b633eb2c31ff`, while the rendered protected contract sets 132 files/28,500 lines and contains 134 base scope entries plus eight recorded scope amendments.
resolutions: Named an exact, falsifiable functional target in Manual Verification 8: serve factory/board/index.html and read the footer.wrap first paragraph and the readinessBlock check-note; the PRIOR chat-approval strings must be absent and "Approve the exact final plan in native Plan Mode." must appear in both. Verified against the committed diff of factory/board/index.html at 9e08774b..HEAD.

Recorded accepted Decision 0082 (docs/decisions/0082-codex-hook-trust-boundary.md) as the load-bearing trust seam under AC1-AC2: authenticity rests on invocation of the exact hash-approved project hook plus exact digest, runtime, session, event, tool, payload, cancellation, replay and candidate validation; no signed host attestation is claimed and synthetic same-user invocation is not excluded. The formal review assesses 0082.

AC16 and AC17 hold by NON-ADOPTION and owe no benchmark: factory/tests/conftest.py is untouched on this branch, so no shared fixture optimisation exists, and nothing in the tree sets a worker count other than the canonical -n 4. Both criteria are conditional permissions; adopting either would first require the recorded 4/6/8 comparison. Recorded in the plan.

Documented the supported reactivation: the git-local control dir is per-worktree and absent in a fresh checkout, so ./forge next routes to GATES-1 and refuses on its retired fixed proof. ./forge story resume FORGE-COORD-1 rebuilds the pointer, protected decomposition and stage tracker from committed state without disturbing GATES-1, and is the prerequisite for ./forge task close LEAN-WORKFLOW.

Corrected the decision grounding: frontmatter active_decisions_reviewed now reads 'accepted corpus through 0082'. The accepted full-access decision is 0081-full-access-for-forge-managed-codex-chats.md; 0079 is a-task-proof-runs-once-per-tree and 0080 is native-role-model-routing, so neither is the full-access destination. Verified by listing docs/decisions/.
